profile.headline: General Dynamics
profile.summary:
I am a hands-on, results-oriented, enterprise software engineer with over 15 years of experience and a passion for learning. I have worked in a wide variety of industries and organizations including Microsoft, JPL, NASA, Symantec, Novartis, ADP, Experian, SAIC, Ford, and Rolls Royce.

My passion is large-scale, cloud-based, mission-critical systems utilizing a range of technologies such as Java, Spring Boot, Snowflake, Kubernetes, Spark, Kafka, Node.js, Python, Docker, AWS, GCP, NoSQL, Azure, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Scala, Golang, and .Net Core. 

I enjoy collaborative, team-based work environments and tackling new challenges in dynamic fast-paced organizations.

Active DoD Security Clearance.

positions.title: SDA - Advanced Cloud Software Engineer
positions.description: Implementation of the Proliferated Warfighter Space Architecture (PWSA) satellite constellation systems for the Space Development Agency (SDA).  Design, development and deployment of the Tranches 1 & 2 cloud and on-premises zero trust infrastructure for the space vehicle vendors and SDA Unified Planning Environment and Resources system.

positions.title: Ground-Space Integration Software Lead
positions.description:
Implemented the Flight Dynamics and Telemetry, Tracking, and Command (TT&C) systems for satellite constellations at Rocket Lab and its customers, increasing spacecraft operations efficiency and flight dynamics efficacy while reducing operational costs.

Key Achievements

• Spearheaded a large-scale enterprise event-driven architecture for the space development agency 
satellite constellation in a zero-trust cloud environment utilizing Kafka and the AWS 
government secret cloud.

• Coordinated with many external parties to construct and implement a hybrid cloud Kubernetes solution targeting AWS EKS, Google GKE, and on-premise deployments.

• Deployed and managed infrastructure using Helm charts, Scaffold, Rancher, MinIO, and 
Terraform across cloud and on-premise environments.

• Developed spacecraft operations and flight dynamics platforms in Python, Java, and C#,
enabling automated spacecraft management.

• Developed a spacecraft Telemetry, Tracking, and Commanding (TT&C) scripting workflow 
engine on Airflow in Python, Celery, RabbitMQ, Asyncio, FastAPI, SqlAlchemy, PostgreSQL, 
and Pydantic.

• Agile Scrum development across many dispersed and disparate teams utilizing Jira, Bitbucket, GitHub, GitLab, Confluence, and SharePoint
positions.insights: Skills: Technical Architecture · Problem Solving · Kubernetes · Terraform · Technical Documentation · Customer Support · PostgreSQL · System Architecture · OOAD · Helm Charts · Debugging · Technical Design · Reliability · Programming · Python (Programming Language) · Distributed Systems

positions.title: Technical Lead
positions.description:
Led the technical development of the Cox consumer intelligence and signals product providing real-time customer insights to Cox product groups and external partners.

Key Achievements

• Technical lead for a dispersed team of Developers and DevOps in a high volume real-time business intelligence product consisting of multiple REST and GraphQL APIs, relational and NoSQL data repositories, and data streams from large consumer websites.

• Stabilized and modernized the suite of applications, migrating infrastructure as code from Terraform to AWS CDK and Typescript, AWS DynamoDB to AWS RDS PostgreSQL and Snowflake, confluent Kafka to AWS MSK, Akka, Scala, and Spark to AWS lambdas.

• Reduced AWS costs by hundreds of thousands by migrating ec2 instances to a serverless architecture.

• Implemented a corporate federated Apollo Typescript GraphQL framework with OAuth2 authentication with 60 ms latency utilizing AWS elastic cache, Fargate, RDS, and Docker.

• Mentored and upskilled team members in new technologies and AWS architectural best practices including CI/CD pipelines using AWS code pipeline, code build, and GitHub actions
positions.insights: Skills: Technical Architecture · Problem Solving · Scalability · Domain-Driven Design (DDD) · Technical Documentation · TypeScript · Java · SQL · Node.js · Customer Support · System Architecture · OOAD · Back-End Web Development · Debugging · Technical Design · Reliability · Snowflake Cloud · Programming · Jenkins · DevOps · Data Structures · Distributed Systems

positions.title: Technical Lead
positions.locationName: Costa Mesa, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Led the technical development of a greenfield project implementing the core consent system for PCI compliant consumer permissioned financial data platform.

• Designed and implemented an internal and public customer-facing secure API gateway providing authentication (OpenID Connect), OpenAPI compliant documentation, developer portal, JSON schema validation, and reverse proxies to backend services. 

• Championed an agile, test, and metric-driven scrum process for a development methodology.
 
• Performed code reviews, implemented services in Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Node.js, and Python utilizing AWS services and infrastructure. 

• Collaborate extensively with DevOps to implement CI/CD solutions for code management and deployments. 

• Designed and developed secure, loosely coupled, message-driven, cloud-based cross-business unit integration gateways utilizing REST services, Kafka, AWS Kinesis, and S3.

Implemented a CI/CD pipeline utilizing Maven, Jenkins, and ECS.

positions.insights: Skills: Problem Solving · Scalability · Domain-Driven Design (DDD) · Technical Documentation · TypeScript · SQL · Node.js · Customer Support · OOAD · Back-End Web Development · Debugging · Technical Design · Reliability · Programming · Data Structures · Distributed Systems

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Working across multiple teams, technologies and projects developed a Data Lake on AWS S3 incorporating a distributed Data Processing Pipeline using AWS EMR, with Hadoop, YARN, Spark 2.1, Scala 2, Java 8, Docker, ECS, DynamoDB, Lambda and RDS MySQL. 

Led the agile development of a cloud-based interactive Business Intelligence data visualization product displaying large, complex data sets, utilizing .Net Core, Web API, JavaScript, HTML5, Redis Cache, OAuth2 security and SQL Server

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Modernized and scaled a low latency, high volume, global Ad Tech Click Stream API from legacy .Net to AWS RESTful microservices utilizing Golang, Java, Kinesis,  SQS, DynamoDB, S3, and Redis; deployed on ELB load balanced EC2 and Docker containers.

Designed and developed high volume event streaming data replication services to extract and transform relational data from SQL Server to AWS S3 JSON files and Redis.

positions.description:
Led the architecture and development of JPL's experiment and operational risk management system, designing and implementing a single page web application in .Net, WCF, SQL Server, SharePoint, WWF, WIF, Java, and Oracle. 

Implemented JPL's federated SSO security framework enabling single sign-on across JPL, AWS Federal Cloud, and Caltech utilizing SAML 2.0, OpenID Connect/OAuth2, Shibboleth, and ADFS.

Supported complex and fuzzy searches over billions of unstructured email text and data. 

Prototyped new search architectures on SolrCloud, Elastic Search, Hadoop, Cassandra, and MongoDB.
